curriculumHighlights.text: B.Tech Regulations 2024 set a 160-credit (plus 3) degree over 58 courses: 56 credits of General Institute Requirements common to all branches, 52-55 credits of programme core, 36 credits of programme/open electives and 16 credits of essential laboratory work.

sources.title: B.Tech. Regulations 2024, B.2.2 credit distribution table

curriculumHighlights.text: An optional B.Tech (Honours) requires 15 extra credits from the department's honours basket starting in semester 5, with a minimum SGPA of 8.5 in every semester and at least a B grade in each honours course.

sources.title: B.Tech. Regulations 2024, B.3.0(5) and B.20.3 Honours eligibility

curriculumHighlights.text: A Minor is earned with 15 additional credits (at least five courses) from a single other department, available from semester 3; the minor certificate is issued separately alongside the degree.

sources.title: B.Tech. Regulations 2024, B.3.0(6) and B.20.4 Minor eligibility

curriculumHighlights.text: A compulsory summer internship or industrial training of at least six weeks after semester 6 carries 2 credits, assessed through a report and viva; final-year project work may also be done through Training & Placement internships or outside the institute.

sources.title: B.Tech. Regulations 2024, B.8.6 Internship / Industrial Training Evaluation

curriculumHighlights.text: Students can spend semester 7 or 8 at an approved foreign or Indian institution under exchange, study-abroad or academic-attachment programmes, provided courses already completed at NITT are not repeated.

sources.title: B.Tech. Regulations 2024, B.8.7 Study Abroad / Exchange Program

curriculumHighlights.text: NEP-style exit option: a student may leave after three years with a B.Sc. in the engineering discipline and return within the 12-semester maximum duration to finish the B.Tech.

sources.title: B.Tech. Regulations 2024, B.2.12 Exit and Re-Entry Provision

curriculumHighlights.text: Online (NPTEL/SWAYAM-type) courses of at least 12 weeks and short microcredit courses can be counted for credit; a student may register up to 28 credits a semester excluding honours, minor and online courses, and up to 25% of a course can be delivered by industry experts.

sources.title: B.Tech. Regulations 2024, B.2.11 industry experts, B.4.0(c) credit cap, online courses

curriculumHighlights.text: The 2024 regulations contain no branch-change (change of programme) clause; students should assume the branch allotted at admission is final unless the institute notifies otherwise.

sources.title: B.Tech. Regulations 2024 (full text; no change-of-branch provision)

research.note: NIT Trichy runs Ph.D. programmes in all 17 departments and M.S. (by Research) in the engineering departments. Per its NIRF 2025 submission it had 649 full-time and 172 part-time doctoral scholars in 2023-24 and graduated 185 Ph.D.s that year; sponsored research brought in about Rs 9.1 crore from 35 projects and consultancy about Rs 6.9 crore in FY 2023-24. The institute also hosts a Param Porul supercomputing facility, a Centre of Excellence in Manufacturing and a Sophisticated Instrumentation Facility.

sources.title: NIRF 2025 data (IR-E-U-0467): Ph.D. pursuing till 2023-24 - full time 649, part time 172; graduated 2023-24 136 FT + 49 PT; sponsored research and consultancy tables
